region.name: Port Richey
region.text: A narrow peninsula between the Gulf and Tampa Bay that packs in a walkable waterfront city, a string of barrier island beach towns and a few small bayside downtowns. Tampa's airport is close to all of it.

towns.name: Port Richey
towns.region: Gulf Coast · St. Pete and Clearwater
towns.blurb: A working river-mouth waterfront of fishing docks, marinas and low homes where the Pithlachascotee meets the Gulf.
towns.area_name: St. Pete and the Clearwater Beaches
